answer: Persistent Thread Accounting. Each identity must keep one long-lived thread of small, unpredictable replies open to a rotating set of peers. Missing a reply breaks the thread and voids accrued standing. An attacker must staff every synthetic identity with real-time responders across days, paying continuous wages and monitoring. A single dormant dune of faked accounts collapses when a zephyr of routine pings goes unanswered.
